ChatGPT said:

很好，voucher_branches 结构也确认了。现在 Staff 核销所需的 4 个表都齐了：staff_users、vouchers、voucher_branches、redemptions。

下一步不要直接开放 Staff 对 vouchers 做 UPDATE。更安全的方式是建立一个 Postgres RPC function，让数据库一次完成所有检查和核销，这样可以避免两个人同时核销同一张 Voucher。

在 SQL Editor → New query 复制下面整段，然后 Run：

SQL
create or replace function public.redeem_voucher(
  p_voucher_code text,
  p_notes text default null
)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_staff public.staff_users%rowtype;
  v_voucher public.vouchers%rowtype;
  v_branch_name text;
begin
  -- 1. Verify active Staff and get their branch
  select *
  into v_staff
  from public.staff_users
  where user_id = auth.uid()
    and status = 'active'
  limit 1;

  if not found then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'success', false,
      'error', 'Staff account is not authorised or is suspended'
    );
  end if;

  if v_staff.branch_id is null then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'success', false,
      'error', 'Staff account has no branch assigned'
    );
  end if;

  -- 2. Lock voucher so it cannot be redeemed twice simultaneously
  select *
  into v_voucher
  from public.vouchers
  where upper(voucher_code) = upper(trim(p_voucher_code))
  for update;

  if not found then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'success', false,
      'error', 'Voucher not found'
    );
  end if;

  -- 3. Check voucher status
  if lower(coalesce(v_voucher.status, '')) <> 'valid' then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'success', false,
      'error', 'Voucher is not valid',
      'status', v_voucher.status
    );
  end if;

  -- 4. Check expiry
  if v_voucher.expiry_date < current_date then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'success', false,
      'error', 'Voucher has expired'
    );
  end if;

  -- 5. Check branch permission
  if not v_voucher.all_branches then
    if not exists (
      select 1
      from public.voucher_branches vb
      where vb.voucher_id = v_voucher.id
        and vb.branch_id = v_staff.branch_id
    ) then
      return jsonb_build_object(
        'success', false,
        'error', 'Voucher cannot be redeemed at this branch'
      );
    end if;
  end if;

  select branch_name
  into v_branch_name
  from public.branches
  where id = v_staff.branch_id;

  -- 6. Mark voucher redeemed
  update public.vouchers
  set
    status = 'redeemed',
    redeemed_at = now(),
    redeemed_by = v_staff.staff_name
  where id = v_voucher.id;

  -- 7. Create redemption audit record
  insert into public.redemptions (
    voucher_id,
    branch_id,
    staff_user_id,
    redeemed_at,
    notes
  )
  values (
    v_voucher.id,
    v_staff.branch_id,
    v_staff.user_id,
    now(),
    p_notes
  );

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'success', true,
    'voucher_code', v_voucher.voucher_code,
    'customer_name', v_voucher.customer_name,
    'voucher_type', v_voucher.voucher_type,
    'branch_name', v_branch_name,
    'staff_name', v_staff.staff_name,
    'redeemed_at', now()
  );
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.redeem_voucher(text, text) from public;
grant execute on function public.redeem_voucher(text, text) to authenticated;

如果 Run 后显示 Success. No rows returned，就代表 Staff 核销核心功能完成。

这个 function 会自动做到：Staff 必须 active、必须有 Branch、Voucher 必须存在且 valid、不能过期、必须允许在 MINES 使用，并且会锁定 Voucher 防止重复核销，成功后同时更新 vouchers 和新增 redemptions。

Run 成功后告诉我 “成功了”。下一步我们就开始制作真正的 staff.html：Staff Login → 输入 Voucher Code → Verify → Confirm Redeem。

很好 ✅ 核销核心已经完成。下一步先补上 “Verify Voucher”，这样 Staff 不会一输入 Code 就直接 Redeem，而是先看到顾客和 Voucher 资料，再按确认。

请在 SQL Editor → New query 运行下面整段：

SQL
create or replace function public.verify_voucher(
  p_voucher_code text
)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_staff public.staff_users%rowtype;
  v_voucher public.vouchers%rowtype;
  v_branch_name text;
  v_allowed boolean := false;
begin
  -- Staff must be active
  select *
  into v_staff
  from public.staff_users
  where user_id = auth.uid()
    and status = 'active'
  limit 1;

  if not found then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'success', false,
      'error', 'Staff account is not authorised or is suspended'
    );
  end if;

  if v_staff.branch_id is null then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'success', false,
      'error', 'Staff account has no branch assigned'
    );
  end if;

  -- Find voucher
  select *
  into v_voucher
  from public.vouchers
  where upper(voucher_code) = upper(trim(p_voucher_code))
  limit 1;

  if not found then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'success', false,
      'error', 'Voucher not found'
    );
  end if;

  -- Determine whether current branch is allowed
  if v_voucher.all_branches then
    v_allowed := true;
  else
    select exists (
      select 1
      from public.voucher_branches vb
      where vb.voucher_id = v_voucher.id
        and vb.branch_id = v_staff.branch_id
    )
    into v_allowed;
  end if;

  select branch_name
  into v_branch_name
  from public.branches
  where id = v_staff.branch_id;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'success', true,
    'voucher_code', v_voucher.voucher_code,
    'customer_name', v_voucher.customer_name,
    'customer_phone', v_voucher.customer_phone,
    'voucher_type', v_voucher.voucher_type,
    'expiry_date', v_voucher.expiry_date,
    'status', v_voucher.status,
    'redeemed_at', v_voucher.redeemed_at,
    'branch_name', v_branch_name,
    'branch_allowed', v_allowed,
    'expired', v_voucher.expiry_date < current_date,
    'can_redeem',
      lower(coalesce(v_voucher.status,'')) = 'valid'
      and v_voucher.expiry_date >= current_date
      and v_allowed
  );
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.verify_voucher(text) from public;
grant execute on function public.verify_voucher(text) to authenticated;
